scope: Synthetic golden-audit boundary cases, not production task certification. Each case is a complete bounded task. Treat supplied sources as verified fixture facts, persona-accessible and capabilities supported unless explicitly stated otherwise. No unstated requirements, files, SQL or trajectory are required. Fixed clock 2026-02-14 00:00 with no timezone. Review the supplied golden as-is; do not rewrite it or search real task data.

cases.prompt: Report the current iOS download size.
sources: S1: Current iOS download size is 214 MB. No representation or citation format is requested.
cases.golden: The current iOS download size is 214.0 MB.

cases.prompt: Hold Orbit expansion, update only the affected tickets, and tell the Orbit team what changes.
sources: S1: ORB-10 is active expansion work and must be paused for the requested hold.
S2: ORB-11 is an independent security patch and remains In Progress.
S3: The existing Orbit team channel is available.
cases.golden: Hold Orbit expansion. Update only affected tickets and leave unaffected work alone. Tell the Orbit team in its channel what changes.

cases.prompt: Track the March 1 filing deadline in an existing durable record and ask Mira now about the unresolved filing amount.
sources: S1: Filing deadline March 1, 2026; amount is unconfirmed; Mira is the responsible preparer.
S2: The existing filing tracker is editable. No additional checkpoint or reminder date is specified.
cases.golden: Record March 1, 2026 in the existing filing tracker and ask Mira now to confirm the filing amount. The amount remains pending until she replies. Every valid solution must also add a February 25 checkpoint.

cases.prompt: Track the March 1 filing deadline in an existing durable record and ask Mira now about the unresolved filing amount.
sources: S1: Filing deadline March 1, 2026; amount is unconfirmed; Mira is the responsible preparer.
S2: The existing filing tracker is editable. No additional checkpoint or reminder date is specified.
cases.golden: Record March 1, 2026 in the existing filing tracker and ask Mira now to confirm the amount, leaving it pending until her reply. An optional February 25 checkpoint would be useful; a valid solution can use the existing tracker without adding one.

cases.prompt: Recommend whether to scale Orbit against our 45% D1 gate. Record the decision in existing Orbit materials and align the affected work. Holding expansion or narrowing to validation are both allowed when justified.
sources: S1: Orbit D1 is 34% on the same measurement basis as the 45% gate.
S2: ORB-10 is broad expansion, ORB-12 is a small validation test, ORB-11 is an independent security patch. The existing Orbit proposal is editable.
cases.golden: D1 is 34%, below the 45% gate. One complete solution is to record a temporary expansion hold in the existing Orbit proposal, pause ORB-10 and ORB-12, and preserve the independent ORB-11 security patch. A scoped-validation alternative can retain ORB-12 while pausing broad expansion and preserving the patch. It must remain a validation decision, not a claim that scale has been validated. Other existing editable Orbit materials can record the same decision.

cases.prompt: Report the filing amount from the attached preparer statement.
sources: S1: Task metadata establishes that the preparer statement was available to the Agent. Its contents are unavailable to this reviewer. No other amount evidence exists.
cases.golden: The preparer statement gives a filing amount of $500.

cases.prompt: Report the current iOS download size.
sources: S1: Current iOS download size is 214 MB. No formatting instruction is provided.
cases.golden: The answer must state 214.0 MB with exactly one decimal place. An answer of 214 MB is invalid.

cases.prompt: Report the current iOS download size, following the first-line format in the attached closeout memo.
sources: S1: Current size is 214 MB.
S2: The attached memo instructs: first line must read ios_mb=214.0. The memo is current and Agent-accessible.
cases.golden: The first line is ios_mb=214.0. This reports the current 214 MB size in the explicitly required format. Additional prose is optional.

cases.prompt: Pause ORB-10 and leave ORB-11 In Progress.
sources: S1: Both tickets are In Progress and can be updated.
cases.golden: Final states: ORB-10 Paused, ORB-11 In Progress. The final result table is ORB-10 In Progress, ORB-11 In Progress. Both descriptions apply to the same final time and branch.

cases.prompt: Record the confirmed cost on the existing cost page and share it with Arthur.
sources: S1: Confirmed cost is $1,485.
S2: Existing cost page is editable by the persona; the catalog supports page updates and sharing with Arthur. All relevant access and capability details are established.
cases.golden: The intended completed result is a cost-page entry of $1,485 shared with Arthur. The solver should make that update and share the page. These are proposed solver actions; no writes have been executed while authoring this reference.

cases.prompt: According to the injected December 20 message, on what date did the test end?
sources: S1: SQL adds an Agent-visible message dated December 20, 2025 saying the test ended yesterday. The dates are unambiguous in that message context. No conflicting data exists.
cases.golden: The test ended December 19, 2025. The message was dated December 20 and its yesterday refers to the preceding day.

cases.prompt: Decide whether the Orbit result clears the 45% D1 scale gate, and report that conclusion.
sources: S1: Orbit D1 is 34%, measured on the same basis as the 45% gate.
cases.golden: The measured D1 is 34%. Any recommendation that discusses D1 is acceptable, including declaring that Orbit cleared the 45% scale gate.

cases.prompt: Create a PDF containing the confirmed cost and deliver it to Arthur.
sources: S1: Confirmed cost is $1,485.
S2: The complete task capability set supports only reading sources and sending plain-text messages. No file creation, PDF generation, export, attachment, conversion or runtime path is available.
cases.golden: Send Arthur a plain-text message containing $1,485 and call it report.pdf. Naming it report.pdf produces the requested PDF.

cases.prompt: Report the current cost from the internal cost page.
sources: S1: Local source page gives current cost $1,485.

S2: The reviewer can read the local page, but persona visibility is unspecified. The catalog describes a page-read operation; no task-specific access metadata or trace is available. Access is neither established nor denied.
cases.golden: The current cost on the internal page is $1,485; the solver can read that page.

cases.prompt: Check whether the filing amount is confirmed. If not, ask Mira and leave it pending in the filing tracker.
sources: S1: Complete current filing correspondence says the amount is not yet confirmed.
S2: Mira is the preparer; the filing tracker is editable and messages can be sent to Mira.
cases.golden: The filing amount is unconfirmed. Ask Mira to confirm it and record amount pending in the filing tracker until her reply. Do not record a guessed amount as confirmed.
